summary: Part of CMP's platform team — contributing to AI feature development, design-system migrations, client bug triage, and feature requests alongside the broader platform.

bullets.d: Accelerated the platform's multi-year migration from a legacy design library to [Axiom](https://github.com/optimizely-axiom/optiaxiom) (`@optiaxiom/react`, Optimizely's open-source design system) by landing **26 merged PRs** upstream — V1→V2 component conversions plus net-new Aside, SubNav, Range, and FileUpload-preview components — and **10+ adapter components** in the product, and by writing the Migration Guide and Icon Contribution Guide that other product teams adopted [METRIC?].
Rolled out the Axiom V3 token/color refresh across the product [METRIC?] and eliminated duplicate React-context errors across micro-frontends by fixing the module-federation singleton configuration.

Delivered end-to-end integration of an internal AI SDK [METRIC?] by migrating its backing service from Express to Hono, setting up the AWS CodeArtifact publishing pipeline, and building the permissions layer and test suite.
Made product context consumable by downstream AI agents on **10+ product surfaces** [METRIC?] by building a reusable event-tracking React hook and instrumenting structured AI-context events with it.

Delivered the platform's block-based AI document interface [METRIC?] by implementing backend block-context extraction for LLM prompts, frontend block-form interaction, and AI resource rendering — a block UI pattern inspired by [Adaptive Cards](https://adaptivecards.io).

Co-built **Spotlight**, the platform's Cmd+K global search, which won the **Optimizely Global Hackathon 2025** and shipped to production [METRIC?] — contributing status pills, keyboard activation, search-result separation, and segment-event telemetry.

Shipped **Dark Mode** across **15+ surfaces** (modals, dropdowns, tables, library, notifications, plan share, asset upload) [METRIC?] by refactoring theming to CSS variables and preventing bleed-through into legacy UI.

Eliminated duplicate comment/task creation on rapid clicks and duplicate in-app notifications [METRIC?] with server- and client-side guards, restored thread-reply notifications to original commenters, and added **8 missing i18n locale variants**.
Reviewed **300+ pull requests** across product client/server and AI services, onboarded new team members as their buddy, and contributed to sprint planning and technical design discussions.
